report.shape: JOURNALING_UNAVAILABLE_DISPOSITIONS: frozen object, total over the seven EVENT_CLASSES, values fail-open/fail-closed, key-set equality asserted at module load (ADJ-JOURNALING-POLICY-INCOMPLETE). security/authority/recovery/verification-scope fail closed; candidate/privacy/external-side-effect fail open because each is represented by every event or every offer and therefore discriminates nothing. journalingUnavailableDisposition() refuses an undeclared or prototype-chain key (ADJ-JOURNALING-POLICY-UNDECLARED). resolveJournalingUnavailability() composes strictest-wins and returns the frozen pipeline.agent-journaling-gap.v1 record. acknowledgeOfferUnderJournalingGap() applies it in the offer lifecycle, returning the record when fail-open and attaching it to ECO-JOURNALING-FAIL-CLOSED when fail-closed.
